I’m Mohammed Baballah Alsiddig Mohammed, a developer focused on turning complex workflows into software that feels straightforward.

My projects explore business management, passenger transportation and school displays. I care about how the interface, the underlying data and the people using the product fit together.

I work iteratively: understand the problem, build the foundation, test the workflow, then improve the details.
